traits.name: Glass Armor
traits.text: When the sand sentry takes fire or lightning damage, its outer layer of sand fuses into sheets of hardened glass for 1 minute. This increases the sand sentry's AC to 26 and grants it resistance 5 to acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, piercing, and slashing damage. A sand sentry can't use earth glide while glass armor is active.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.text: A living boulder can Burrow through earthen matter, including rock. When it does so, it moves at its full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.

traits.name: Blinding Sand
traits.text: When the sand sentry critically hits with a fist Strike, the target is blinded for 1 round.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ fist +17 Damage 2d8+8 (2d8+8) bludgeoning plus blinding sand
